presence_rationale: Dedicated sections on Whistleblower Policy/Program, ABAC Policy, AML/CTF Program, sanctions compliance, fraud, Code of Conduct. Topic comprehensively addressed.
specificity_rationale: Detailed governance: Whistleblower Policy with jurisdiction-specific country schedules, Whistleblower Program with case management, role-specific training for Board/Executive Committee whistleblower recipients, ABAC Policy and Framework, AML/CTF risk assessments at enterprise and country level, enhanced due diligence triggers, sanctions compliance program. Multiple substantive controls and accountabilities described.
quantification_rationale: Reports operational metrics: 142 new whistleblower reports (10% decrease YoY), 76% of investigated reports led to recommended actions, 195 awareness sessions delivered (vs 116 in 2021), bank-wide staff survey conducted. Whistleblower-side disclosure is strong with YoY tracking. SASB FN-CB-510a.1 metric (monetary losses from legal proceedings) is not present in retrieved evidence.
